scope.input: The complete verified tsfg.core-array-candidate v11 module, not a selection of functions or an independent narrower Source profile.
scope.result: An opaque versioned static packet; no execution entry, interpreter, VM/AOT/Host/storage/GC ABI, kernel authority or Source reconstruction.
scope.unsupported: Whole-module refusal for everything outside the unchanged actual Core11 verifier: extra/mixed candidates, types/attrs/ops/regions/CFG, View parameters/results/aliases, or an active View crossing a direct call. No leaf/function dropping or scalar identity projection.

canonicalInput.proofs: Run whole existing Core11 verification before measuring/encoding. At every direct call recompute all live-before Array SSA roots; for every checked View creation recompute owner/create/last-use from all actual operands. If optional supplied call_roots or view_lifetimes differs at all, refuse. Existing verifier inserts nonempty tables; input supplied empty vs absent is nonsemantic presence. Packet always carries both complete tables, including zero counts. It does not preserve original optional-presence bits.
canonicalInput.otherAttributes: Every original non-proof attribute must match the existing exact Core11 allowlist and types/relations. Unknown attributes remain rejected; no generic attribute passthrough or metadata laundering.
canonicalInput.identity: Validate original private function/signature/binding/site identities before encoding, without changing the original module identity. The canonical decoded model reconstructs all validated metadata/SSA and normalized proof tables. Original identity preimages unavailable in Core remain explicitly opaque provenance.

sha256[32] of UTF8 RFC8785 JCS(this entire descriptor), no LF

primitives.u64: unsigned64 LE; f64 uses original IEEE754 bits, never a numeric cast
primitives.Hash: exact32 raw bytes from canonical lowercase prefixed sha256: string; decode restores exact lowercase prefix/string
primitives.Utf8: u32 byte length followed by exact well-formed nonempty UTF8 without NUL; no normalization; at most1048576 bytes
primitives.Range: u32 start,u32 end; original half-open UTF16 code-unit offsets, 0<=start<end<=65536. Do not use UTF8 byte length or truncate65536 to16bits.
primitives.Seq8: u8 count then records in stated order; check actual per-role maximum before allocation
primitives.Seq16: u16 count then records; used where256 or4219/4245 must fit
primitives.Type: u8 exact tags none=0,f64=1,u32=2,Array<f64>=3,ReadSpan<f64>=4; these are this private family tags, never formal wire9 codes
primitives.OptionalLocalAnnotation: u8 0 means both canonical local annotation arrays empty; u8 1 followed by annotation Range,elementAnnotation Range; other tags reject. Array/View create requires1; alias may0. No independent mixed-empty representation.
primitives.ScalarUse: u8 kind tag constant=1,floating=2,reference=3,arrayReadChecked=4,readSpanReadChecked=5; reference then Hash binding, other kinds imply exact empty binding; then Hash typeId,Range. Role-specific kinds/types and exact SSA-definition binding/anchor are independently validated.

widthReasons.u16: Dense register IDs/count<=4219 and instruction IDs/count<=4245; create operand count reaches256; call-root register count may reach4219. No u8 operand count or alias collapse. No-result register sentinel65535 is outside valid registers.

opcodes.name: tsfg_core.fuel
opcodes.meaning: Exactly one entry op, full function range; retained Fuel promise, not executed.

opcodes.name: tsfg_core.constant
metadata: u64 original16 lowercase finite f64 hex bits if result f64; u32 original canonical decimal value if result u32
opcodes.meaning: Reconstruct original unique literal StringAttr exactly; never round via host float. Role index literal max4294967294; start/length/resize max4294967295. Full u32 parameters retain future checked obligations.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.create
opcodes.meaning: Keep every original fresh owner/literal occurrence and ordered element SSA, including empty Array; no element/storage evaluation, folding, DCE or allocation execution.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.alias
opcodes.meaning: Exact earlier same-function parameter/local receiver definition; preserve alias SSA and original chain, same owner, no copy/collapse.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.read_checked
opcodes.meaning: Receiver then index once; retain original checked index<=4294967294 then index<length before future read. Static packet does not perform or pretrap the access.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.store_dense_checked
opcodes.meaning: Receiver,index,RHS evaluated once in that order; RHS checked read completes before store. Preserve future valid-index check then <=length before mutation; overwrite vs exact-end append, no gap/growth initialization.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.resize_checked
metadata: Hash exact original Array length property
opcodes.meaning: Receiver then full-u32 newLength; preserve check newLength<=currentLength before mutation. Same owner; no zero-fill, silent growth or length substitution.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.view_create_checked
opcodes.meaning: Owner,start,length once, precise nominal checked view. Future checks start<=owner.length then length<=owner.length-start; never use wrapping start+length or create a physical handle/new owner.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.view_read_checked
opcodes.meaning: Exact View owner retained; checked index<=4294967294 then index<view.length before future access; existing final-return/store-RHS placement only.

opcodes.name: tsfg_array.view_length
metadata: Hash exact original readonly View length property
opcodes.meaning: Actual discarded readonly length expression; real operand use extends View last-use. No Array known-length substitution.

opcodes.name: func.call
opcodes.meaning: Whole local callee identity/signature/source binding; original scalar literals/references or Array reference actuals only, no nested-call actual or View. Preserve discarded or immediate final-return result, source sequence and exact dense SSA.

opcodes.name: func.return
opcodes.meaning: Final exact checked Array/View read or immediately preceding final direct-call result, with original return statement range; no detached result/value substitution.

validation.whole: Reuse the existing whole Core11 verification before producer encoding. An independent cold reader validates all finite fields/types/cardinalities/source relations, exact identities/tables, complete local call graph and all op semantics as static constraints before publishing an opaque model. No supplied boolean/proof summary is authority.
validation.identities: Function/signature/binding/allocation-site preimages are exactly the existing Core11 RFC8785 finite grammar, UTF16 ranges and valid UTF8 with no NFC. Current core descriptor identity formulas are authoritative. SourceHash/inputIdentity/requestId bind retained provenance; packet alone cannot recover unavailable Source text, packet/HIR hashes or Source export-AST membership.
validation.completeness: Ordered function_ids must equal all encoded function records, each exactly once, including private/unreachable/recursive functions. Exports are the exact encoded original sorted unique subset and resolve to exact whole-table name/id. A self-consistently removed unreachable private function cannot be detected against unavailable Source by a packet-only reader; producer whole-Core validation and independent whole binary gold establish preservation relative to the actual input.
validation.source: Retain all18 original allowed module attrs via Module fields, including full2 sources/4 nominal origin rows and3 property/intrinsic records; exact pinned minimal-arrays-v3.d.ts metadata/ranges/hash. Source and export ordering uses unsigned UTF8 byte comparison as Core11, not locale, normalized Unicode or JS UTF16 sort.
validation.statementSSA: Number all entry args then op results in encounter order; every operand references the exact defined earlier register and required type. Re-enforce entire Core11 statement grammar and source-order/range nesting, constant/alias/property/argument bindings. Every op consumed once; no extra detached constant/read, hidden block/region, dropped local, alias-root collapse or instructions reordered across checks.
validation.density: Static finite length knowledge only: each fresh literal count exact, aliases share owner; all Array parameter owners stay permanently unknown and may alias every other parameter owner. Literal store permits known overwrite/exact append only; known literal resize cannot grow. Unknown index/call kills affected knowledge. All Array actual roots and aliases become unknown after any direct call, even a read-only-looking callee. Checked ops remain present regardless of any proof; no future access evaluated.
validation.roots: Independent backwards live-before transfer: remove op results, add actual operands; at each direct call include every Array SSA value still live and every Array actual, sorted unique by register. Retain aliases as independent SSA roots, not only distinct owners. Exactly one record for every call, including empty root list. Compare entire transmitted canonical table.
validation.views: Independent forward owner map: fresh create owner=self, Array parameter owner=self with parameter may-alias, alias inherits original root, checked View owner=actual Array operand root. Last-use scans all actual View operands including discarded length; unused last=create. Canonical View records ordered by create instruction and exactly compared. At every mutation strictly create<instruction<last, same-root or parameter-to-parameter may-alias needs proven known-fresh overwrite(index<knownLength) or equal-length resize; otherwise refuse. Zero-length View does not erase borrow. Any ordinary call strictly inside active lifetime refuses; no interprocedural purity/GC/borrow ABI inference.
validation.scc: Compute direct-call closure over every complete function. Each cyclic node and its full outgoing reachable domain must contain neither Array create nor View checked-create. Acyclic incoming entry may allocate its actual before passing it to a recursive parameter-only function. Retain entry Fuel1; no blanket recursive refusal or allocation guard removal.
validation.canonical: Both proof tables always represented as normalized lists; absence and explicitly supplied [] are encoded identically after equality verification. All other validated metadata is retained or uniquely reconstructed from exact enum/type representation. No generic model projection or original private identity replacement.
validation.integers: Before every counted read/write/allocation verify count<=role cap and count<=remainingBytes/recordMinimum when applicable; avoid overflow with limit-used subtraction and division before multiplication. Use full-u32 arithmetic in wide checked host integers for static ranges and metadata; future access checks are retained, not run.

publication: Bound input to limit+1 before MLIR parsing for the new explicit flag; keep all existing flag behavior. Validate entire Core, measure complete packet/header/metadata, enforce output8MiB and only then publish stdout atomically. Any invalid input or budget/encoding failure emits zero packet bytes; diagnostics on stderr. Existing common fixed-width/hash primitives may be reused, no general execution launcher.
oracle: Freeze complete packets/decoded DTO/continuous field offset coverage from independently authored existing whole Core/SSA/root models before producer or reader implementation. Existing7 actual packages remain complete; marker-only v10->v11 declaration migration is explicit and changes no Source/identity/SSA/metadata. Separate2 pre-existing cold-only length positives and self-consistent hash-repaired negatives have no new Source credit.
